title: Nobel Prize 2026: Switching Brain Cells On and Off With Light
description:
The 2026 Nobel Prize in Medicine went to Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel for optogenetics.
A light-sensitive protein from a tiny green alga now lets scientists switch chosen nerve cells on or off with light.
